css-mediaquery: BSD 3-clause text in its LICENSE file (Yahoo), OSI approved; the package metadata only says BSD. Needed by react-admin.
require-like@0.1.2: MIT text in its License file (Felix Geisendörfer); the package metadata has no license field. Needed by Docusaurus (through eval).
config-chain@1.1.13: MIT text in its LICENCE file (Dominic Tarr); the package metadata only gives a license object without an SPDX id. Needed by Docusaurus (through update-notifier).
caniuse-lite: CC-BY-4.0 browser support data, not code. Read only while the docs site is built (browserslist) and absent from the published pages.
mdn-data: CC0-1.0 CSS reference data, not code. Read only while the docs site is built (css-tree) and absent from the published pages.
khroma: MIT text in its license file (Fabio Spampinato, Andrew Maney); the package metadata has no license field. Needed by Docusaurus theme-mermaid (through mermaid).
org.jdom:jdom2: JDOM licence: the Apache-1.1 text without its acknowledgment clause, a BSD-style licence the OSI does not list under this text. Used only by SpotBugs while the backend is built; it is in no image or jar of the product.
org.tukaani:xz@1.9: Public domain dedication of the xz Java library, not an OSI licence (later versions are 0BSD). Used only by a Maven plugin while the backend is built; the product uses the 0BSD versions or none.
ra-language-english@5.15.5: MIT text in its LICENSE.md (Marmelab); the lockfile has no license field for it. Needed by react-admin.
eval@0.1.8: MIT in its package.json (licenses) and in its LICENSE file (Pierre Curto); the lockfile has no license field. Needed by Docusaurus.
format@0.2.2: MIT in its package.json (licenses, sjs.mit-license.org); the package has no license file and the lockfile has no license field. Needed by Docusaurus.
github.com/xi2/xz: Public domain dedication of its authors in the license file of the module (XZ Embedded), not an OSI license. Linked into the pgschema binary that the backend image carries.
Codicons (codicon.ttf in monaco-editor): Icon font of Microsoft vscode-codicons under CC-BY-4.0 (its code is MIT), shipped as codicon.ttf inside monaco-editor. It is an asset, not code; the web bundle carries its attribution in third-party-licenses.txt.
org.jboss:jboss-transaction-spi: Declared Public Domain in its POM, not an OSI license. A library of the Keycloak distribution in the sso image.
org.latencyutils:LatencyUtils: Declared CC0-1.0 (public domain dedication) in its POM, not an OSI license. A library of the Keycloak distribution in the sso image, used by Micrometer.
LZMA SDK (7z): Public domain dedication in lzma.txt of the LZMA SDK, not an OSI license. Built into libclamav, in the clamav image.
bzip2: The bzip2 license, a BSD-style license that the OSI does not list under this text. Built into libclamav, in the clamav image.
Adobe Core 14 font metrics (AFM files in: Adobe's own permission notice for the 14 AFM files (SPDX APAFML): use, copying and distribution for any purpose without charge, keeping the notices; not an OSI license. Data inside the pdfbox jar of the backend image, with its text in /licenses of that image.
Font Awesome shapes (in pdfbox): Glyph shapes of Font Awesome under CC-BY-4.0, not an OSI license. Data inside the pdfbox jar of the backend image, with its attribution in /licenses of that image.
CMYK ICC profile (in pdfbox): Color profile released under CC0-1.0, not an OSI license. Data inside the pdfbox jar of the backend image.
DX-OS record classifier data: CC-BY-4.0 data of the team (sentences and label definitions), not code. In the repository at the paths that check_licenses.py names; in no image.
MASSIVE vi-VN: CC-BY-4.0 data of Amazon, not code. Downloaded when the classifier is trained; in no image or release.
SLURP: CC-BY-4.0 data that MASSIVE is built from, not code. Downloaded only inside MASSIVE; in no image or release.
